how_bowlers_were_told_apart: Two stable POV clusters across all 32 clips. A (21 clips: 104714-110948, 113541-115157): looks down at the approach in stance, ball below view, own head shadow visible, bare forearms, navy/red swirl ball. B (10 clips: 111238-113113): carries a black ball with yellow inserts up at chest height, dark navy long sleeves, wedding band. Names come from the overhead monitors: the pair is lanes 27/28, bowlers alternate lanes each frame and each monitor shows the bowler on its lane. The wearer's lane (ball hitting the rack right of the 26|27 or left of the 28|29 masking label) matched the monitor showing "Tom" in game 3 (114631, 114810) and "Chris" in game 2 (111238, 112146); the wearer's pin counts matched the board rows (game 1 frame 2 not a strike = Tom; game 2 frames 1 and 5 left pins = Chris, Tom struck). The board spells the second bowler "Chris"; this map labels B "Chardie" because the brief says Tom and Chardie took turns and only Tom and Chris appear on the boards.
game_boundaries: Game 1 = 104714..110948 (10 clips, frames 1-10, wearer Tom); 111218 is a no-throw clip showing the game-1 finals (Tom 123, Chris 169). Game 2 = 111238..113113 (10 clips, frames 1-10, wearer Chardie/"Chris"; boards at 111238 empty, through 9 at 113113; finals Tom 197, Chris 187 from series pinfall). Game 3 = 113541..115157 (11 clips, wearer Tom; 113541 board empty; 115105 is frame 10 ball 1, 115157 a 10th-frame bonus ball; Tom 144 thru 9). Game-2 and game-3 frame numbers are pinned by scoreboard reads in 9 clips; game-1 frames are by order plus strict 27/28 lane alternation (no in-game board read). Capture gaps: 2.5 min (110948->111218), 4.5 min (113113->113541).
